name: grit
description: Microprogrammed 16-bit machine: ATF22V10C logic, SST39SF040 program flash and microcode ROM, AS7C164A SRAM, TL16C550 UART on its own crystal, MAX811L reset, 4 MHz oscillator with a single-step switch, debug LEDs, analyzer headers, 5 V barrel jack.

chips.name: j1
chips.part: DB9 female, right angle, through hole

bus_descriptions.ADDR: The address bus: a 16-bit word address (everything on the bus is a 16-bit word), which is also the A latch's value. A drives it on ADRV, the PC on PCDRV, nobody in the word between. Addr15 and Addr14 pick the chip: 0x = flash (0x0000..0x7FFF), 10 = SRAM (0x8000..0x9FFF, r0..r31 first), 11 = UART (register n at 0xC000 + n).
bus_descriptions.ADRV: Microword bit 11: A drives Addr (and so the ALU sees A). Never in the word next to a PCDRV word.
bus_descriptions.ALD: Microword bit 4: A copies D at the ending edge.
bus_descriptions.ALU0_C1: Carry into bit 1 of ALU slice 0: a macrocell fed back inside the chip; the pin goes nowhere.
bus_descriptions.ALU0_C2: Carry into bit 2 of ALU slice 0 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU0_C3: Carry into bit 3 of ALU slice 0 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU1_C1: Carry into bit 5 of the sum, inside ALU slice 1 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU1_C2: Carry into bit 6, inside ALU slice 1 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU1_C3: Carry into bit 7, inside ALU slice 1 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU2_C1: Carry into bit 9, inside ALU slice 2 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU2_C2: Carry into bit 10, inside ALU slice 2 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU2_C3: Carry into bit 11, inside ALU slice 2 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU3_C1: Carry into bit 13, inside ALU slice 3 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU3_C2: Carry into bit 14, inside ALU slice 3 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALU3_C3: Carry into bit 15, inside ALU slice 3 (internal).
bus_descriptions.ALUOE: Microword bit 2: the ALU drives D.
bus_descriptions.AUX: Microword bits 14 and 15, spare: debug outputs.
bus_descriptions.B: The B latch: the ALU's second operand and the value a store writes. Point-to-point into the ALU.
bus_descriptions.BLD: Microword bit 5: B copies D at the ending edge.
bus_descriptions.CLK: The machine clock: the run/step multiplexer's output, 4 MHz from the oscillator or one edge per press of the step button. Every GAL's clock; every flop moves on its rising edge.
bus_descriptions.CO: The PC's carry from bit 7 into bit 8.
bus_descriptions.COUT: Carry between ALU slices: COUT0 from slice 0 into slice 1, and so on.
bus_descriptions.D: The data bus. One driver per clock: the memory or device that Addr selects on MEMRD, the ALU on ALUOE, or T on TDRV. Read by A, B, T, the PC and the IR at the clock edge.
bus_descriptions.F: Microword bits 9 and 10, the ALU function: F1 F0 = 00 add, 01 and, 10 nor, 11 pass B.
bus_descriptions.IR: The instruction register: the opcode, bits 15:11 of the instruction word. Address bits A5..A9 of the microcode ROM.
bus_descriptions.IRLD: Microword bit 8: the IR copies D[15:11] and the step counter clears at the ending edge. The fetch.
bus_descriptions.LEDA: Between a debug LED and its resistor.
bus_descriptions.LEDB: A 74HC541 buffer output driving a debug LED: the level of the signal named.
bus_descriptions.M: The microcode ROM's data: the next microword, latched into the pipeline register at every edge.
bus_descriptions.MEMRD_n: Microword bit 1, active low: the memory or device that Addr selects drives D. OE# of the flash and SRAM, RD# of the UART.
bus_descriptions.MR: MR_n: the MAX811L's manual reset input, pulled up inside it; the reset button pulls it low.
bus_descriptions.MR_n: The reset button, to the MAX811L's manual-reset input (pulled up inside the part).
bus_descriptions.NE: The not-equal chain: NE0 out of ALU slice 0 (bits 0..3 differ), NE1 (bits 0..7), NE2 (0..11) and NE3 (all: A differs from B), each slice taking the previous one in. NE3 feeds the NEL flop in the sequencer's flags chip.
bus_descriptions.NEL: The condition, in the sequencer's flags chip: NE3 latched at the end of every word in which A is on the bus (ADRV), held otherwise. Address bit A4 of the microcode ROM.
bus_descriptions.OSC: The 4 MHz oscillator's output, into the run/step multiplexer and the clock header.
bus_descriptions.PBANK: Program flash bank: A15..A18 of the program flash, from the 4-position DIP switch (pulled up; ON = 0; every switch ON here): 16 banks of 32 K words.
bus_descriptions.PCDRV: Microword bit 0: the PC drives Addr, and counts a word at the edge. Also the flash's OE# through MEMRD.
bus_descriptions.PCINC: Microword bit 7: PC += 2 at the ending edge.
bus_descriptions.PCLD: Microword bit 6: the PC copies D at the ending edge.
bus_descriptions.RESET: Reset synchronised to CLK, active high, from the sequencer's flags chip: a factor of every product term in the IR, step counter, pipeline register, PC and NEL; the UART's MR.
bus_descriptions.RS: RS1: the first stage of the reset synchroniser in the sequencer's flags chip, RST_n sampled on CLK. RESET is the second stage.
bus_descriptions.RST_n: The MAX811L's reset output, active low: power-on and the button.
bus_descriptions.STEP: The step counter: cleared by the fetch, counting every other clock. Address bits A0..A3 of the microcode ROM.
bus_descriptions.STEPBTN: STEPBTN_n: the step button, pulled up, with 100 nF for debounce; low while pressed.
bus_descriptions.STEPCLK: The debounced step button through a Schmitt inverter: high while pressed, so a press is a rising edge of CLK in step mode.
bus_descriptions.STEPMODE: The slide switch: low = run (CLK is OSC), high = single step (CLK is the step button). Change it while holding reset.
bus_descriptions.TLD: Microword bit 12: T copies D at the ending edge.
bus_descriptions.UBANK: Microcode bank: A10..A12 of the microcode ROM, from three positions of a DIP switch (pulled up; ON = 0; every switch ON here): 8 microcode images.
bus_descriptions.UBAUD: BAUDOUT# to RCLK: the baud generator clocks its own receiver.
bus_descriptions.UCTS_n: The UART's CTS#, from the transceiver's second pair.
bus_descriptions.UDTR_n: DTR# looped back to DSR# and DCD#: the modem status always reads ready.
bus_descriptions.URTS_n: The UART's RTS#, to the transceiver's second pair.
bus_descriptions.VF: 5 V after the polyfuse, at the reverse-polarity MOSFET's drain.
bus_descriptions.VIN: The barrel jack's centre pin, 5 V in.
bus_descriptions.WE_n: Microword bit 3, active low: the memory or device that Addr selects takes D. WE# of the SRAM, WR# of the UART, for the whole clock.
bus_descriptions.XC_c1A: SP3232 charge pump: C1+ to its capacitor.
bus_descriptions.XC_c1B: SP3232 charge pump: C1- to its capacitor.
bus_descriptions.XC_c2A: SP3232 charge pump: C2+ to its capacitor.
bus_descriptions.XC_c2B: SP3232 charge pump: C2- to its capacitor.
bus_descriptions.XIN: The UART's own crystal, 14.7456 MHz: divisor 8 is 115200 baud. Nothing to do with the bus clock.
bus_descriptions.XOUT: The other side of the UART's crystal.
